Text-only sentence-boundary dev review

The model input columns contain punctuation-free text: left context and 1–2 following words. “Target mark” is label metadata from the original punctuation position; it is not part of either input field. EOT targets are sentence-final punctuation; NEOT targets are internal punctuation. These are crawled prose labels, not dialogue or human-audio gold. This page lists corpus rows across train/dev/test; prediction cells remain pending until dev inference is recorded, and test rows are never used for checkpoint selection.
